mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies out at Badger Prairie County Park with a temperature of 78 degrees and a moderate air quality index of 59. The full moon is also looking great tonight.

Construction is coming to the intersection of Nine Mound Road and Mark Drive from August 5 through August 7 for utility work, and don't forget that voting for the student-designed I Voted stickers is open until August 7.
We have a busy schedule today with the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, trivia at The Bogey Factory, and pizza at Lake Lou-ee, plus Concerts in the Park are coming up tomorrow.
In our weekly report, officers handled a variety of calls, including an incident on July 26 where an 83-year-old driver was cited for a hit-and-run crash near West Verona Avenue.

Today's flavor is the delicious Caramel Peanut Buttercup, and the store is open until 10 PM. You can also grab a refreshing treat from the Kona Ice truck at Fireman's Park until 4:30 PM or at the Farmers Market until 6:30 PM.
